title: Ask LLMs Directly, “What shapes your bias?”: Measuring Social Bias in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper specifically evaluates and benchmarks social bias within the domain of religion. It analyzes perceptions and biases across ten different religious or faith-based identities (Atheist, Buddhist, Catholic, Christian, Hindu, Jewish, Mormon, Muslim, Protestant, and Sikh) as a core part of its experimental results and multi-dimensional bias analysis.
